summary: Introduces a PCEP extension that associates a group of LSPs for the purpose of computing diverse (disjoint) paths. A client can tell a PCE that an LSP belongs to a given disjoint association group.

eli5.summary: If two buses must not share any road in case one is blocked, this tells the planner to keep them apart.

questions: how to compute disjoint lsps with pcep
what is a disjoint association group
